data.title: AION shifts major software development to 32-bit Artemis

actions.description: Presents Artemis-exclusive Abacus 3.0 and Pulse 3.0; makes Artemis the main target for major development. Abacus adds schema-defined formatted tables alongside worksheets, bounded columnar storage, calculated columns and lookups, a read-only SQL subset, graphical reports, embedded Pulse and CSV/host-exported VSAM logical-record imports.

COMDEX follow-up to the Artemis campaign: publish native software demonstrations and compatibility progress while preserving Aurelia/Aurelia+ maintenance and independent manufacturers’ compatibility programme.

Demonstrate imported sales records joined with customer/product data, margin calculations, grouped graphical reporting and repeatable Pulse automation. Qualify RAM, disk use, correctness, recovery and timings; do not advertise guaranteed compression ratios or unlimited datasets.

outcomes.description: Aurelia receives maintenance and simplified refreshes.

Abacus 3.0 addresses 1980 business workflows. Broader nested-data/query capabilities and direct competition with the historical 1983 Lotus 1-2-3 belong to a later Abacus version; its number and release date remain unspecified.
